ambiguities.question: Is an endpoint-only value automatically a useful invariant?
ambiguities.resolution: No. A public endpoint hash is a proves-too-much control; the value must provide recipient asymmetry and actual-message correctness.

ambiguities.question: Does a complete ring held by KeyGen automatically yield endpoint inversion?
ambiguities.resolution: No. The decoder must be explicit and polynomial-time on the exact public distribution.

ambiguities.question: Does a field-size choice establish Category 5?
ambiguities.resolution: No. Normative target, attacks, reductions, costs, and parameters are separate evidence obligations.
